# Hirani Marketing Combines

> Water pump and industrial equipment supplier and repair workshop in Parrys, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. In business since 2008 — 17+ years serving homes, businesses and industrial plants across Tamil Nadu.

## Products We Supply

- Water pumps: domestic monoblock, submersible, centrifugal, chemical, industrial
- RO & water filtration systems (Kent, Aquaguard, and others)
- UV water purifiers and water softeners
- Fountains and water features
- Pressure washers and high-pressure pumps
- Air compressors (piston, belt-drive, screw types)
- Hydro pressure test pumps (manual and motorised high-pressure plunger pumps)
- Hydraulic equipment and industrial spare parts

## Brands We Carry (Authorised Dealer)

Kent, Aquaguard, CRI, Kirloskar, Grundfos, Crompton, Texmo, Shakti, Wilo, Pentair

## Repair & Servicing

Workshop repair and reconditioning for:
- All water pump types (domestic, submersible, centrifugal, chemical, industrial)
- RO systems, UV purifiers and water filters
- Air compressors
- Hydro pressure test pumps — manual and motorised, pipeline testing, fire system testing
- Hydraulic equipment

Repair process: inspect → quote (before work starts) → recondition with genuine parts → performance test → return.
Standard turnaround: 48–72 hours. Same-day diagnosis and quote.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2008 (17+ years in the trade)
- In-house repair team — no outsourcing
- Genuine branded products only — authorised dealer for major brands
- No work begins before a quote is accepted — transparent pricing
- Walk-in workshop: drop equipment, collect repaired
